text: A little green lizard. <break time="0.8s" /> A butterfly, and a daisy. <break time="0.8s" /> Asked why he was weeping. <break time="0.8s" /> He is weeping for a red rose. <break time="0.8s" /> Said the Nightingale. <break time="0.8s" /> For a red rose. <break time="0.8s" /> How very silly. <break time="0.8s" /> They cried. <break time="0.8s" /> And the lizard laughed out loud. <break time="0.8s" /> But the Nightingale understood his sorrow. <break time="0.8s" /> And she sat silently. <break time="0.8s" /> In the oak tree. <break time="0.8s" /> Suddenly she spread her brown wings. <break time="0.8s" /> And flew to a rose tree. <break time="0.8s" /> In the middle of the grass. <break time="0.8s" /> Give me a red rose. <break time="0.8s" /> And I will sing you my sweetest song. <break time="0.8s" /> She cried. <break time="0.8s" /> But the tree shook its head. <break time="0.8s" /> And said, My roses are white. <break time="0.8s" /> The yellow rose tree. <break time="0.8s" /> That grew by the old sundial. <break time="0.8s" /> Also shook its head. <break time="0.8s" /> At last she found the rose tree. <break time="0.8s" /> Which grew beneath the Students window. <break time="0.8s" /> My roses are red. <break time="0.8s" /> It said. <break time="0.8s" /> But the winter has chilled my veins. <break time="0.8s" /> And the storm has broken my branches. <break time="0.8s" /> There is a way. <break time="0.8s" /> But it is so terrible. <break time="0.8s" /> That I am afraid to tell you.
